title: SUIT · deep cerebellar nuclei
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Locate each original deep cerebellar nuclei assignment in source MRI, categorical surface and probability views.

scenes.title: Left Dentate · source probability
scenes.prompt: Locate the selected source compartment in the T1 sections. Compare its continuous probability field with its delivered categorical extent, and identify the surrounding nuclear groups in the complete 3D context.
scenes.note: Original source label 29 (Left_Dentate). Separate 23-participant nuclear atlas; the population T1 supplies common spatial context. Continuous support and delivered categorical boundaries are separate source products. Each native array retains its original physical coordinates.
